ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace armored assault vehicle officers, but it will change command methods. Systems can handle target recognition, fire-control calculations, and battlefield information fusion, shifting officers from calculation and monitoring toward decisions and leadership. Uncrewed vehicles and robotic platforms will enter formations, but officers remain responsible for turning people and equipment into an effective force.
ai_s2_accel: Experiments with formations of uncrewed combat vehicles and robotic platforms
AI-assisted wargaming for comparing tactical options
Digital command systems for faster order distribution
High-fidelity training simulators for opposing-force exercises
ai_s2_auto: Automated target recognition and fire-control calculations
Automated fusion and display of battlefield awareness
Electronic training records and performance assessments
Automated equipment and logistics statistics
ai_s3_list: Tactical decisions: rapidly changing conditions require an officer's broad judgment.
Command and motivation: officers organize morale, discipline, and determination.
Training and development: officers identify individual weaknesses and improve them.
Coordination: officers connect branches in combined operations.
Accountability: officers answer for the consequences of the crew's actions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score reflects a career centered on command and decisions. AI takes over data processing and calculation, while battlefield decisions, unit training, and equipment coordination depend heavily on officer experience and leadership and remain difficult to replace in the near term.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no change. Digitized and uncrewed equipment is entering service quickly. Officers who command both crewed systems and uncrewed formations will become more valuable, while those who avoid digital command systems and only understand traditional methods risk falling behind.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For a military command path, pursue an armored or command program at a military academy or a direct officer commission after university. Build fitness, discipline, and resilience early. Interest in AI and digital equipment provides an advantage during this transition.

Master digital command systems and simulation tools and participate actively in coordinated exercises with uncrewed equipment. Add technical understanding to leadership experience and develop into a commander who understands tactics, data, and uncrewed systems.

Military career channels are limited and specialized, primarily serving military academy graduates and directly commissioned officers. People with technical backgrounds can consider equipment support and command information system roles before developing within the organization.
Officer selection should prioritize decision quality, leadership ability, and willingness to learn new technology. Training budgets should emphasize uncrewed equipment and digital command.

ai_s7_trends: Mixed formations of uncrewed combat vehicles and crewed armor are emerging, requiring commanders to lead both types of force.
AI wargaming and digital simulation are spreading, shifting training from primarily live-fire exercises toward combined virtual and physical methods.
Digital command systems continue to improve, shifting core officer skills from tactical experience alone toward decisions, data, and coordination.

ai_s2_accel: 无人战车与机器狗编队协同试验
AI 兵棋推演辅助战术方案比选
数字化指挥系统提升指令分发速度

战场态势信息自动融合显示

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的主体是「指挥与决策」，AI 接管的是数据处理和计算环节；战场决策、带兵训练和装备统筹高度依赖军官的经验与领导力，短期看不到被替代的可能。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于不变：信息化和无人化装备在快速进场，未来「能指挥有人装备、也能驾驭无人编队」的军官更值钱；被时代落下的，是不会用数字化指挥系统、只懂传统打法的军官。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走军事指挥路线，首选军校装甲/指挥类专业或大学直招军官。提前锻炼体能、纪律性和抗压能力；对 AI 和数字化装备有兴趣的孩子，在这轮转型里更有优势。
把数字化指挥系统、模拟对抗工具用熟，主动参与无人装备协同演训；带兵之外补齐技术认知，往「懂战术 + 懂数据 + 懂无人」的复合指挥官转型。
军事岗位通道有限且特殊，主要面向军校生、国防生和直招军官；有技术背景的可关注装备保障、指挥信息系统等技术军官方向，先入体系再谈发展。
选拔军官时把「决策质量 + 带兵能力 + 学习新技术意愿」放在前面；培训预算要向无人装备与信息化指挥倾斜。

AI 兵棋推演和数字模拟普及，训练方式从实弹为主转向虚实结合。
信息化指挥体系持续升级，军官的核心能力从「战术经验」转向「决策 + 数据 + 协同」。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically compare rates, book shipments, and generate a complete set of documents. But when every slot is full, the person who can still find space for your container is not in the system; they are on the other end of the phone.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 100,600 Cargo And Freight Agents were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 109,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 8,600 jobs, with approximately 8,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $49,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace many standard freight-forwarding tasks. Online quotes, automated booking, document generation, and real-time cargo tracking have already moved to digital platforms. The remaining value lies in exception handling, capacity coordination, urgent customs issues, and client relationships. When rules cannot solve the problem, human experience and connections matter.
ai_s2_accel: AI capacity forecasting and booking recommendations
Intelligent customs clearance and risk-control support
Automated multimodal transport recommendations
Client self-service inquiry and ticketing platforms
ai_s2_auto: Online booking and real-time freight rate comparison
Automated document generation and review
Automated cargo status tracking and notifications
Automated customs data filing
ai_s3_list: Exception handling: develop immediate solutions for cargo delays, damage, and stalled customs clearance.
Capacity and transport coordination: secure scarce space in peak season through relationships and sound judgment.
Client relationships: maintain long-term accounts and advocate for clients when it matters.
Regulatory expertise: understand trade terms and changes in customs policy.
Multi-party coordination: keep carriers, customs brokers, warehouses, and clients aligned.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 places this role in the moderate AI exposure tier. Booking, documentation, and tracking are highly digitized and increasingly handled by platforms and AI, leaving exception handling and client development as the main sources of human value.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure means that pure data-entry roles are shrinking. At the same time, once digital platforms remove tedious operations, freight agents can focus on higher-value exception handling and business development. People who only relay messages face risk, while those who understand the rules, have strong networks, and solve emergencies become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study logistics management or international trade, and build a strong foundation in trade terms, customs regulations, and English. Go beyond routine order processing by learning data analysis, cross-border e-commerce, and digital platforms, which are core tools for freight agents in the AI era.

Make exception handling and client development your signature strengths, and actively learn digital freight platforms. Move from operations into business development, international operations, or management because the path for pure data-entry work is narrowing.

A background in foreign trade, customer service, or sales supports a smoother transition. Start in operations or customer service to learn the workflow, then move into business development. In interviews, highlight experience resolving delays or damage and coordinating capacity with carriers.

After digitization, hire for exception handling and client communication, not just operational proficiency. Use transparent commissions and clear client-account allocation to retain business-oriented agents with valuable networks.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Online booking, rate comparison, and tracking
Online issuance and transfer of bills of lading
Client information and order follow-up records

ai_s7_trends: As digital freight platforms spread, booking and documentation move fully online, operations roles continue to contract, and workers shift toward exception handling and business functions.
Growth in cross-border e-commerce and multimodal transport is increasing demand for versatile freight agents who understand trade rules and can develop client relationships.
As AI capacity forecasting and intelligent customs tools enter production, data skills are becoming a core competitive advantage for freight agents.

body: Cargo And Freight Agents arrange transportation for imports and exports, including booking capacity, preparing documents, coordinating customs clearance, tracking cargo, and settling freight charges. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年货物与货运在岗约 10.06 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.92 万人，净增约 0.86 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.88 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.99 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会替代大量标准货代操作：在线询价、自动订舱、单证自动生成、货物实时跟踪，都已被数字化平台接管。留下的价值在异常处理、舱位协调、报关突发情况应对和客户关系——规则解决不了的时候，靠的是人的经验和人脉。
ai_s2_accel: AI 舱位预测与订舱建议
智能报关与风控辅助
多式联运方案自动推荐

单证自动生成与审核
货物状态自动跟踪与通知

ai_s3_list: 异常处理：货物延误、破损、清关卡壳，现场拿方案。
舱位与运力协调：旺季抢舱位，靠关系也靠判断。
客户关系：长期客户要维护，关键时刻替你说话。
规则经验：贸易条款、海关政策变化，要读得懂。
多方协调：船司、报关行、仓库、客户，中间人在转。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这是个「流程高度数字化」的岗位：订舱、单证、跟踪这些标准操作已经被平台和 AI 大量接管，异常处理和客户经营成为剩余价值所在。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光对应的现实是「纯录单员在减少」。但反过来，数字化平台把繁琐操作做掉后，货代更能专注于高价值的异常处理和业务开发；只会「传话」的人危险，懂规则、有人脉、能救火的人反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选物流管理、国际贸易方向，把贸易术语、海关法规和英语打扎实。别只学「跟单操作」，多学数据分析、跨境电商和数字化平台，这些是 AI 时代货代的核心工具。
把「异常处理和客户经营」练成招牌能力，主动学数字化货运平台。从操作岗往业务开发、海外操作和管理方向走，纯录单的路越走越窄。
有外贸、客服或销售背景的转行较顺。先做操作或客服熟悉流程，再转业务开发；面试突出「处理过延误/破损、跟船司协调过舱位」的经历。
数字化之后，招人重点看异常处理和客户沟通能力，别只看操作熟练度。建议用「提成透明 + 客户资源分配」留住有客户资源的业务型代理。

ai_s7_trends: 数字化货运平台普及，订舱单证全面线上化，操作岗持续压缩，人员向异常处理与业务端转移。
跨境电商与多式联运增长，懂贸易规则、会经营客户的复合型货代更稀缺。
AI 舱位预测与智能报关落地，数据能力成为货代的核心竞争力。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年石膏板与天花板瓷砖安装工在岗约 10.31 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.74 万人，净增约 0.43 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.77 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代石膏板安装工。搬运、切割、填缝、找平这些高度依赖手感与现场判断，短期自动化难做到；预制墙板与电工具在减负，但交房质量仍靠人。真正变化是体力活变轻，不是岗位消失。
ai_s2_accel: 预制墙板普及
激光找平辅助
排版软件下料
工期排程工具
ai_s2_auto: 石膏板切割机
自动上钉工具
升降作业平台
粉尘收集设备
ai_s3_list: 现场找平：眼手判断。
补缝打磨：手感定。
工种配合：现场协调。
异形处理：靠经验。
质量自检：人把关。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——活儿高度依赖手上功夫和现场判断，系统难替，但工具升级在减轻体力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：被优化的是纯体力搬运，不是安装本身。会用电工具、能带班的人反而更吃香。怕的是只肯出蛮力、不愿学新工具。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不想坐办公室可走中职学徒，早学手艺早赚钱，AI 时代这行稳。
学预制与电工具，往带班、包活走，单价更高。
从帮工做起，突出肯学、能扛，工地缺熟练工。
选手稳心细的，能自检平整的师傅值得给日薪溢价。

ai_s7_trends: 预制墙板减少现场活。
电工具减轻体力。
翻新需求托底就业。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can screen case files, search statutes, and draft reports. But deciding whether the person behind a complaint was actually treated unfairly requires someone to sit down and hear the full story.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 418,000 Equal Opportunity Representatives And Officers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 430,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 12,300 jobs, with about 33,300 openings each year. The approximate median annual wage in 2026 is $78,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Equal Opportunity Representatives And Officers. Investigations depend on face-to-face interviews, combined judgment about motives and facts, and a commitment to speak for people with less power. AI cannot assume that role. It can accelerate document search, data checks, and report drafting, leaving people more time for investigation and communication.
ai_s2_accel: Automated classification and prioritization of complaints
Transcription and analysis of investigation interviews
AI pre-screening for policy compliance
Automated creation of training and awareness materials
ai_s2_auto: Automated screening for discriminatory language
Initial calculation of pay and promotion disparities
Intelligent search across statutes and regulations
Template-based drafting of investigation reports
ai_s3_list: Interview judgment: encourage complainants to speak openly while maintaining boundaries.
Factual judgment: reconstruct events from conflicting accounts.
Empathy and principle: understand harm while insisting on evidence.
Organizational coordination: make corrective action happen instead of merely submitting a report.
Commitment to fairness: speak for people who lack influence.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 indicates moderate exposure in a document-heavy occupation. AI can greatly accelerate statutory searches, data checks, and report drafting. Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Investigation judgment, interviews, and corrective-action work remain human responsibilities. The role's value depends on resolving facts that are difficult to establish.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure requires active adaptation. Use AI for pre-screening, transcription, and search, then spend the saved time on in-depth interviews and cross-department coordination. Officers who use AI to shorten investigations and strengthen reports gain influence within compliance systems.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Law, human resources, and sociology provide strong foundations. Add courses in data analysis and communication. These roles are limited but valuable and suit students who care about justice and can sustain painstaking work.

Move from HR or legal work into employee relations and compliance. Pursue credentials in labor-relations coordination or compliance. Use AI for document processing while strengthening investigation interviews and evidence judgment.

HR, legal, and social work backgrounds transfer well. Prepare a specific example of resolving a conflict or complaint for interviews. Explain the process and result; that is more useful than reciting regulations.

These roles are difficult to fill. Consider candidates with HR or legal backgrounds and train them through internal transfers. Provide compliance tools to reduce documentation work and define a path toward Compliance Lead or Head of Employee Relations to retain talent.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Identify discriminatory language in job postings
Generate a first draft of an investigation report

ai_s7_trends: Stricter diversity, inclusion, and fair-employment regulation increases demand for compliance roles.
AI pre-screening and data analysis become standard investigation tools, improving efficiency.
Roles increasingly integrate with HR, legal, and ESG systems, favoring multidisciplinary talent.

body: Equal Opportunity Representatives And Officers monitor and enforce anti-discrimination and equal-opportunity policies. They investigate complaints involving sex, age, race, disability, and other grounds, review employment policies for compliance, and promote a culture of fairness.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can screen case files, search statutes, and draft reports. But deciding whether the person behind a complaint was actually treated unfairly requires someone to sit down and hear the full story.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你筛卷宗、查条文、起草报告，但「这个投诉背后的人是不是真的受了委屈」——这个判断，需要一个人坐下来听完。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年代表官在岗约 41.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.03 万人，净增约 1.23 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.33 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代平等机会代表官：调查的核心是面对面的访谈、对动机与事实的综合判断，以及替弱势方说话的立场，这些 AI 无法承担。AI 能加速的是文书检索、数据核查、报告起草，把人的精力腾出来做真正的调查与沟通。
ai_s2_accel: 投诉案件自动分类与优先级排序
调查访谈记录转写与分析
政策合规性 AI 预审
培训宣导材料自动生成
ai_s2_auto: 歧视条款的文本自动筛查
薪酬与晋升数据偏差初算
法规条文智能检索
调查报告模板化起草
ai_s3_list: 面谈分寸：让申诉人敞开心扉又不失边界。
事实判断：在双方说法间还原真相。
同理与原则：理解委屈，也守住证据。
组织协调：推动整改落地而不是交报告了事。
立场担当：替没有话语权的人说话。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这行属于「中高曝光」的文书型岗位：条文检索、数据核查、报告起草占比大，AI 能大幅提效。但中高曝光不等于高风险——调查判断、面谈沟通、整改推动都是 AI 接不走的，真正决定岗位价值的是「能不能查清一个说不清的事」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着要主动升级：把 AI 用来做预审、转写、检索，把时间省下来做深度访谈和跨部门协调。能用 AI 把调查周期缩短、把报告做扎实的代表官，在合规体系里的分量会更重。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这条路的，法学、人力资源、社会学都是好底子，建议再修数据分析和沟通课程。这类岗位编制少但含金量高，适合孩子有正义感又坐得住冷板凳。
从 HR 或法务转岗到员工关系与合规方向，考劳动关系协调师或合规相关认证；把 AI 工具用于文书处理，专注提升调查访谈和证据判断这两门硬功夫。
有 HR、法务、社工背景的转行优势大；面试时准备一个「你处理过冲突或投诉」的具体案例，讲清楚过程与结果，比背法规条文有用得多。
这类岗位难招，建议接受「HR/法务背景 + 内部转岗培养」的组合，配合规工具降低文书负担；明确晋升到合规负责人或员工关系负责人的路径，人才才留得住。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 招聘文案歧视条款识别

ai_s7_trends: 多元包容与公平雇佣监管趋严，合规岗位需求上升。
AI 预审与数据分析成为调查标配，效率明显提升。
岗位与 HR、法务、ESG 体系融合，复合型人才更吃香。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate a hundred bouquet concepts in three seconds, but a Floral Designer still has to understand the recipient, occasion, and emotion in person.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 43,800 Floral Designers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 41,200 by 2034, a net loss of about 2,600 jobs, with about 5,100 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $36,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Floral Designers, but it will take over inspiration and desk work. Image generation, color suggestions, inventory, and quotes become faster, returning the designer's value to craft + aesthetics + communication. Fresh flowers are perishable, living materials whose quality depends on the setting. Standardized machines cannot reproduce the judgment in handmade work.
ai_s2_accel: AI color tools that inform palette decisions
E-commerce and delivery platforms expand sales reach
Online floral courses and live streams expand income
Fresh-flower preservation and intelligent care equipment become widespread
ai_s2_auto: AI-generated bouquet concepts and inspiration
Digital flower purchasing, price comparison, and inventory management
Digital quotes and order management
Assisted social media layout and publishing
ai_s3_list: Color and form aesthetics: turn a feeling into a palette and shape.
Flower handling: trim stems, preserve materials, and extend vase life.
On-site creation: adjust designs to the venue and lighting.
Customer communication: translate vague requests into specific work.
Cost and waste control: balance visual quality with profit.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. AI assists with inspiration and desk work, but floral design centers on craft + aesthetics + on-site service. These tasks depend on a designer's senses and experience, limiting replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure is manageable. Floral Designers who use AI for concepts and content can reach more customers and raise order values. Basic bouquet makers who compete only on price face pressure. Custom, wedding, and brand services offer stronger premiums.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Floral design is a craft and aesthetics field, not a degree competition. Start with a month or two in a flower shop to test your tolerance for long standing hours and seasonal peaks. Pursue formal training only after confirming the fit, and do not open a shop blindly.
Specialize in higher-value wedding and brand floral work. Use AI concepts and content operations to broaden customer sources. Your portfolio is your calling card, and consistent updates matter.

People with design or service backgrounds transition well. Build strong flower-handling and basic bouquet skills before custom work. Bring a portfolio to interviews or sales meetings and explain your understanding of each occasion. That is more persuasive than a certificate.
Hire Floral Designers for their portfolios and aesthetic judgment, not tenure alone. Creative freedom and stable schedules retain talented people. AI tools can reduce desk work and raise output.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Cold storage and longer vase life

ai_s7_trends: AI concept generation and content operations are spreading, shifting Floral Designers from making arrangements to making arrangements + building brands.
Custom and experience-based consumption is growing, expanding premiums for highly aesthetic floral services.
Online flower retail pressures basic stores, making differentiation and emotional value stronger defenses.

body: Floral Designers create arrangements and provide floral services. They select and prepare flowers, make bouquets and baskets, maintain shop displays, and install floral work for weddings and events. Color, form, and texture express the meaning of each occasion.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate a hundred bouquet concepts in three seconds, but a Floral Designer still has to understand the recipient, occasion, and emotion in person.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能三秒钟生成一百种花束效果图，但「这束花送给谁、什么场合、什么心情」，还得花艺师当面读懂。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年花艺设计师在岗约 4.38 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.12 万人，岗位净减约 0.26 万个，年均产生约 0.51 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.61 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代花艺设计师，但会接管灵感与案头：AI 出图、配色建议、库存报价都能提速，花艺师的价值回到「手作 + 审美 + 沟通」。鲜花是易损、有生命、讲究现场感的商品，机器的标准化永远替代不了手作里的分寸。
ai_s2_accel: AI 配色工具辅助色彩搭配决策
电商与配送平台扩大销售半径
线上花艺课程与直播拓展收入
鲜花保鲜设备与智能养护工具普及
ai_s2_auto: 花束效果图 AI 生成与灵感参考
花材采购比价与库存管理电子化
报价单与订单管理数字化
社交媒体内容排版与发布辅助
ai_s3_list: 色彩与造型审美：把「感觉」落到配色和形态上。
花材处理手艺：剪根、保鲜、延花期的硬功夫。
现场创作：根据场地和光线临时调整方案。
客户沟通：把模糊的需求翻译成具体作品。
成本与损耗控制：在好看和赚钱之间找平衡。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明灵感和案头工作正被 AI 辅助，但花艺的核心是「手作 + 审美 + 现场服务」，这些环节依赖花艺师的感官和经验，AI 替代度有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不必慌：会用 AI 出图和内容运营的花艺师，接单半径和客单价都更高；被挤压的是只会做基础花束、靠低价竞争的花店店员。往定制、婚礼和品牌服务走，溢价空间反而更大。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 花艺不是学历赛道，是审美和手艺赛道。建议先去花店实习一两个月，看自己是否真能接受长时间站工和季节性忙碌；有兴趣再系统学培训，别盲目开店。
把婚礼花艺、品牌花艺等高客单方向做精，用 AI 出图和内容运营扩大客户来源。作品集是你的名片，坚持更新比什么都重要。
有设计或服务背景的转花艺很顺；先把花材处理和基础花束练扎实，再谈定制。面试或接单时带作品集，说明你对场合的理解，比证书更有说服力。
招花艺师看作品和审美判断，别只看年限；给创作空间和稳定排班，能留得住有才华的花艺师。用 AI 工具帮他们减少案头时间，产出会更高。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 效果图与配色方案生成

ai_s7_trends: AI 出图与内容运营普及，花艺师从「做花」走向「做花 + 做品牌」。
定制与体验式消费升级，高审美花艺服务溢价持续扩大。
线上鲜花电商挤压基础零售，差异化与情感价值成为护城河。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can control temperature and record data for every batch, but operators still need to open the machine, inspect the aroma and color, and taste the product.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 29,700 Food Cooking Machine Operators And Tenders employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 29,900 by 2034, a net gain of about 200 jobs, with roughly 4,400 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $40,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace some food-machine operator roles, but the occupation will remain. Systems are taking over temperature control, parameter records, and scheduling, while highly automated lines need fewer operators. People are still needed for on-site sampling, sensory judgment, equipment maintenance, and food-safety checks. As safety oversight tightens, operators who understand processes and make sound judgments will have more stable prospects.
ai_s2_accel: AI vision checks for consistent color and appearance
In-line sensors for real-time process-curve monitoring
AI equipment-failure prediction to reduce downtime
Recipe and parameter databases for new-product setup
ai_s2_auto: Automated control and recording of temperature and time parameters
Electronic scheduling and work-order management
Automated generation of batch and traceability data
Automated equipment-condition monitoring and alarms
ai_s3_list: Sensory judgment: people determine whether color, aroma, and taste are right when instruments cannot.
Experience with exceptions: people decide when to stop a machine and how to respond when parameters drift or equipment sounds abnormal.
Equipment-maintenance craft: cleaning, lubrication, and calibration quality determine production-line life.
Food-safety responsibility: a parameter error in one cooking vessel can affect the full batch, so people must verify results.
Communication across stages: people coordinate quality control, maintenance, and production teams.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means about half of the tasks in this occupation are rule-based. Automated controls and software are taking over parameter setup, monitoring, and recording.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces pure machine operation, making on-site sensory judgment, equipment maintenance, and food-safety verification more important. Jobs limited to pressing buttons will shrink, while operators who understand processes, maintain equipment, and make sound judgments will have better prospects.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study food processing, food safety, or electromechanical technology and seek an internship at a large plant. Focus on process parameters, food-safety rules, and equipment maintenance, then plan toward quality control or equipment roles.

Build equipment-maintenance and quality-assessment skills, and earn a relevant food-safety credential. Move from following parameters to understanding processes, maintaining machines, and verifying quality. That is the strongest response to automation.

Food-plant operator roles have a modest entry barrier, so you can begin as an apprentice. A mechanical or food-processing background helps. On your resume, list the lines you operated, processes you learned, and batch pass rates you achieved.

Do not hire operators only for their ability to watch machines. Assess sanitation awareness and exception handling. Employees who maintain equipment, make sound judgments, and follow rules form the foundation of a food-safety system.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Integrated work orders, traceability, and reports

ai_s7_trends: As automation and AI controls spread, pure operator roles will continue to shrink. Operators are moving toward combined operations, maintenance, and quality-control roles.
Tighter food-safety oversight raises batch-traceability and process-compliance requirements, increasing the value of operators who understand standards and make sound judgments.
Predictive maintenance and in-line sensors are becoming standard. Equipment and data skills are emerging as new operator performance measures.

body: Food Cooking Machine Operators And Tenders operate and monitor equipment used to cook, fry, bake, and sterilize food. They control temperature, time, and pressure to process specifications, collect samples, inspect products, and keep records. Their work keeps food processing safe and compliant.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can control temperature and record data for every batch, but operators still need to open the machine, inspect the aroma and color, and taste the product.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动控温、自动记录每锅数据，但开盖那一刻的香气、色泽和口感，还是得靠操作员亲自看一眼、尝一口。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年食品机器操作员看护员在岗约 2.97 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.99 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.44 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.05 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会替代一部分食品机器操作岗，但不会让岗位消失。自动控温、参数记录、排产这些被系统接管，自动化程度高的产线减少操作员编制；但现场取样、感官判断、设备维护和食品安全把关仍需人——食品安全监管越严，懂工艺会判断的操作员越稳。
ai_s2_accel: AI 视觉检查色泽与外观一致性
在线传感实时监控工艺曲线
AI 预判设备故障减少停机
配方与参数数据库支持新品调试
ai_s2_auto: 温度时间参数自动控制与记录
排产与工单电子化管理
批次信息与追溯数据自动生成

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 5,700 metal and plastic layout workers employed in 2024, projected to fall to 5,400 by 2034. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not immediately replace metal layout workers, but it will continue to reduce purely manual layout. Future layout work centers on development and verification rather than simply drawing lines, and graduates who can do both are most welcome on shop floors.

People with riveting, welding, or sheet-metal backgrounds transition fastest. State which workpiece types and software you have used; candidates who perform both layout and CNC verification are more sought after.

Do not recruit layout workers as purely manual tradespeople. Hire versatile technicians who perform traditional layout and developed-pattern verification. Paired with nesting software, improvements in sheet utilization can save far more than the wage premium.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人、金属塑料在岗约 0.57 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.54 万人，岗位净减约 0.03 万个，年均产生约 0.05 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.19 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会立刻取代金属划线工，但会持续挤压纯手工划线：数控切割机直接从编程数据下料、三维放样软件自动生成展开图、激光打标代替划针——画线这个动作本身在被替代。划线工真正保下来的部分，是那些机器处理不了的复杂件：怎么套料最省料、怎么借边留余量、现场尺寸偏差怎么处理，这些经验判断还能吃很多年。
ai_s2_accel: 套料软件自动优化板材利用率
测量设备数字化复核定位
AI 识别图纸自动生成下料数据
车间数据系统全程追溯
ai_s2_auto: 数控切割直接下料省去画线
三维放样自动生成展开图
激光打标替代手工划针
尺寸计算与套料的软件化
ai_s3_list: 复杂件套料经验：异形件怎么排最省料，软件不一定最优。
现场偏差处理：工件变形、毛坯不规整时的临场调整。
划线手艺：大尺寸工件上的长线、圆弧、基准的精准度。
与其他工序的衔接：知道后续怎么切、怎么焊，才能合理留量。
质量责任感：一条线错，整批料废，这种意识机器替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的划线计算与数据环节被数字化工具大量接管，但现场占比不低，属于中高曝光。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光下，分水岭在「会不会数字化」：只会划针钢尺的老手艺在缩量，会套料软件、懂数控下料、能做放样复核的划线工反而吃香。把传统手艺和数字化工具都握住，就是两头通吃。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读机械、铆焊或数控专业，学传统识图也学三维放样软件。未来划线不是「画线」而是「放样与复核」，两手都会的毕业生最受车间欢迎。
把套料软件、三维放样和数控下料知识补起来，从「画线师傅」转成「下料工艺员」。纯手工划线岗在收缩，别守着老手艺不动。
有铆焊、钣金基础的人转型最快。求职时写清你画过什么类型工件、会用哪些软件，能同时做划线与数控复核的候选人更抢手。
别把划线工当纯手工工种招。招既会传统划线、又能做放样复核的复合技工，配合套料软件，板材利用率提升省下的钱远超工资。

ai_s7_trends: 数控下料与三维放样成为主流，手工划线岗位持续收缩。
划线工向「放样工艺员」转型，套料与复核能力成为核心。
复杂非标与修造船场景仍依赖老师傅，手艺有局部市场。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can run tens of thousands of materials simulations, but scientists still need to explain why one structure is more stable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 8,700 Materials Scientists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 9,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with around 600 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $104,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Materials Scientists, but it will restructure R&D. Once AI handles literature searches, experimental data analysis, and composition simulation, scientists shift from processing data toward setting direction, explaining mechanisms, and integrating disciplines. Scarce professionals formulate questions, understand mechanisms, and move materials into production.
ai_s2_accel: Large models assist materials hypothesis generation
Experimental-plan and process-parameter recommendations
Rapid iteration of performance predictions
Cross-database materials knowledge graphs
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent search and summaries of literature and patents
High-throughput simulation screening of composition and performance
Automatic cleaning and fitting of experimental data
Intelligent recognition and labeling of characterization images
ai_s3_list: Mechanism judgment: why one structure performs better.
Experimental design: how to test a hypothesis.
Interdisciplinary integration: combining chemistry, physics, and engineering.
Industrialization judgment: whether a material can scale.
Scientific taste: which direction is worth pursuing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this career in the moderate-high AI exposure tier for research data. AI accelerates retrieval, simulation, and image recognition, while mechanisms and synthesis remain human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces calculation and extraction, not thinking and judgment. Materials Scientists who set direction, explain mechanisms, and drive production become scarcer, while junior data-labeling roles face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build foundations in materials science, chemistry, and physics, and learn programming and simulation early. In the AI era, prioritize mechanisms and industrialization, not only laboratory operations.
Master AI simulation and knowledge graphs and learn engineering and pilot-production fundamentals. Advancing from experiments to production creates greater value.
Highlight the materials you developed, publications, and industry connections. Characterization and simulation results are advantages.
Hire for depth of mechanism understanding and implementation, not publication count alone. Senior experts who lead pilot production deserve premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: Semiconductors and new energy drive new-material R&D demand.
AI simulation and knowledge graphs spread, reducing junior search roles.
Interdisciplinary materials professionals who drive pilot production are scarcer.

body: Materials Scientists study relationships among composition, structure, and properties of metals, ceramics, polymers, composites, and semiconductors, designing new materials and optimizing production through characterization and simulation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把材料仿真跑成几万次筛选，但「为什么这个结构更稳」，还得科学家想明白。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年材料科学家在岗约 0.87 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.91 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.42 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代材料科学家，但会重构研发流程。文献检索、实验数据分析和成分仿真交给 AI 后，科学家从「跑数据」挪向「定方向、解机理、做跨学科综合」。真正稀缺的是能提出问题、看懂机理并把材料推向量产的人。
ai_s2_accel: 大模型辅助提出材料假设
实验方案与工艺参数推荐
性能预测的快速迭代
跨数据库的材料知识图谱
ai_s2_auto: 文献与专利的智能检索摘要
材料成分—性能的高通量仿真筛选
实验数据的自动清洗与拟合
表征图像的智能识别与标注
ai_s3_list: 机理判断：为什么这个结构更优。
实验设计：怎么验证假设。
跨学科综合：化学物理工程拧一起。
产业化判断：能否放大落地。
科学品味：什么方向值得追。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的科研数据区——检索、仿真、图像识别都能被加速，但机理和综合仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「算和摘」，不是「想和判」。会定方向、解机理、推量产的材料科学家更稀缺。怕的是只做数据标注的初级研究岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 材料化学物理打底，早学编程与仿真。AI 时代拼机理与产业化，别只当实验操作员。
把 AI 仿真和知识图谱用熟，补工程与中试常识。从「做实验」升级成「推量产」，价值更高。
突出你做过什么材料、发过什么、和产业怎么对接。有表征和仿真成果优先。
招人看机理深度和落地力，不止看论文数。能带中试的资深专家值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 半导体与新能源拉动新材料研发需求。
AI 仿真与知识图谱普及，初级检索岗压缩。
能推中试量产的复合材料人更稀缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Sensors can measure automatically and systems can keep records, but technicians still decide which hazards are urgent and how to compel people to complete corrective actions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically warn of signal risks, but conductors still make on-site decisions about handling a passenger dispute in one car or routing a train with oversized freight.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 36,800 railroad conductors were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 37,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with about 3,100 openings annually and median annual pay of about $74,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace conductors, but it will take over part of the monitoring. Signal alerts, train monitoring, and dispatch instructions are becoming automated. On-site organization, emergency response, passenger service, and cross-role coordination still depend on people. Railway systems rely heavily on rules and trust, so automation assists rather than replaces people. Whenever passengers are aboard or cargo presents risks, someone must take responsibility.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent dispatch systems optimize train operating plans
AI video monitoring helps identify platform abnormalities
Predictive maintenance detects railcar hazards early
Electronic waybills synchronize freight information in real time
ai_s2_auto: Automated transmission of signal displays and train-movement instructions
Automatic prompts from railcar condition monitoring and alerts
Digital operating records and logs
Automated announcements for ticketing, boarding, and alighting information
ai_s3_list: On-site response: make immediate decisions during passenger disputes, cargo shifts, and other unexpected events.
Organization and coordination: align crews, engineers, dispatchers, and station staff efficiently.
Rule-based judgment: know which rule takes priority in complex situations.
Risk awareness: detect safety risks from subtle abnormalities.
Passenger service: combine following rules with making people comfortable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates a division between automated monitoring and human fieldwork for railroad conductors. Systems take over signals, records, and alerts, while organizing people and handling abnormalities aboard trains remain human work. Automation lets field staff focus more closely on critical tasks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean the role remains unchanged. Intelligent dispatch and predictive maintenance are changing operations, and conductors who use new systems work more efficiently and prevent risks earlier. Combining strong rules knowledge with new-system operation keeps the career path stable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: The railway system is a strong option for families prioritizing stability: campus hiring into railway bureaus provides steady income and comprehensive benefits. However, rotating shifts and holiday duty are required, so introverted students or those unwilling to tolerate hardship should consider carefully. A relevant railway-school program offers the smoothest entry.

Master train-operation rules and actively pursue conductor promotion training and examinations. Also learn intelligent dispatch systems and plan toward station dispatch or operations management instead of remaining satisfied with onboard work.

Open recruitment and labor dispatch are major entry routes into railways, often beginning in conductor-assistant or support roles. Military, transportation, or safety-management backgrounds provide an advantage; emphasize discipline and emergency experience in interviews.

Responsibility + rule execution define conductor roles. Use scenario simulations during hiring to assess emergency response. Provide adequate automation equipment, but do not expect machines to replace on-site judgment; staff training and emergency drills remain essential.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Railcar condition and platform abnormality identification
Automatic verification of boarding and alighting information

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent dispatch and automatic alerts become standard railway tools as operating monitoring continues to automate.
Conductors shift from monitoring operations toward on-site response + organization and coordination.
Railway talent development combines with new technology, increasing demand for multidisciplinary field staff.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动预警信号风险，但「一节车厢的旅客纠纷怎么处理、一列超限货物怎么调度」，还得列车长现场拍板。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年铁路列车长在岗约 3.68 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.72 万人，净增约 0.04 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.31 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.41 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代列车长，但会接管「盯」的部分：信号预警、行车监控、调度指令正在自动化。剩下的现场组织、应急处置、旅客服务和跨岗位协调依然靠人。铁路系统高度依赖规章和信任，自动化是辅助，不是替代——尤其是车上有人、货有风险的时候，必须有人负责。
ai_s2_accel: 智能调度系统优化列车运行计划
AI 视频监控辅助识别站台异常
预测性维护提前发现车辆隐患
电子运单与货物信息实时同步
ai_s2_auto: 信号显示与行车指令自动化传递
车辆状态监测与预警自动提示
运行记录与日志电子化
票务与乘降信息自动播报
ai_s3_list: 现场处置：旅客纠纷、货物异动等突发情况的临场决策。
组织协调：让乘务、司机、调度、站务高效配合。
规章判断：在复杂现场里知道哪条规矩优先。
风险嗅觉：从细微异常嗅出安全风险。
人员服务：把「按规定办」和「让人舒服」结合起来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明铁路列车长岗位正处于「监控自动化 + 现场人工」的分层：信号、记录、预警被系统接管，但列车上人的组织与异常处置仍是人工主场，自动化反而让现场人员能更聚焦关键环节。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于一成不变：智能调度和预测性维护在改变运行方式，会用新系统的列车长效率更高、更能提前规避风险。把规章功底和新系统操作结合起来，职业路径依然稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 铁路系统是「稳定型」家庭的优选：校招进入路局，收入稳定、保障齐全。但要接受倒班和节假日值守，性格内向、怕吃苦的孩子要想清楚。走铁路院校对口专业，入行最顺。
把行车规章吃透，积极参加晋升列车长的培训和考试。同时学习智能调度系统操作，往车站调度、运营管理方向规划，别满足于原地跑车。
铁路社招和劳务派遣是主要入口，先接受从列车员或辅助岗做起。有部队、运输或安全管理背景的人转型有优势；面试时突出纪律性和应急经验。
列车长岗位核心是「责任心 + 规章执行力」，招聘时可用情景模拟题考察应急处置。自动化设备要配到位，但别指望机器替代现场判断，人员培训和应急演练不能省。

列车长职能从「盯运行」转向「现场处置 + 组织协调」。
铁路人才培养体系与新技术结合，复合型现场人才需求上升。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can explain a concept in ten different ways, but when a child does not want to learn or cannot sit still today, a special education teacher still has to crouch down and stay with them.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 94,800 education teachers were employed in 2024, projected to decrease to 93,000 by 2034, a net loss of about 1,800 jobs, with about 6,300 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $64,900 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace middle school special education teachers, but it will change lesson preparation and recordkeeping. In the past, lesson plans relied entirely on experience. Now AI can generate differentiated exercises for each child's IEP and find suitable assistive teaching resources, while also organizing learning records automatically. Yet core work such as classroom interaction, behavioral intervention, and emotional support still depends on people. AI provides resources, but getting a child to engage in learning is the teacher's responsibility.
ai_s2_accel: AI speech-to-text and read-aloud: Support students with reading disabilities
Emotion recognition assistance: AI helps identify signs of changes in students' emotions
Adaptive learning platforms: Adjust difficulty in real time based on student responses
Home-school communication assistant: Generate personalized feedback for parents
ai_s2_auto: IEP documentation assistance: Generate first drafts from templates and goal libraries with one click
Differentiated exercise generation: Automatically create tiered questions by ability level
Digital learning records: Automatically archive classroom observations and assessments
Educational resource search: Quickly match assistive tools, teaching aids, and case studies
ai_s3_list: Behavioral intervention and emotional support: Machines cannot replace knowing how to comfort and guide a child during a meltdown.
Real-time judgment in classroom interactions: If a student does not respond to one explanation today, try another approach.
Trusting relationships with children: A child with special needs learns to trust you through sustained time together.
Creativity in individualized teaching: Turning an abstract concept into something a student can understand is a teacher's skill.
Home-school collaboration and empathy: Sharing pressure with parents requires human warmth.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means half of this occupation's tasks are completed at a desk. AI is providing substantial support for lesson preparation, recordkeeping, and resource searches, but it can only assist with core work such as classroom interaction, behavioral intervention, and emotional support.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. The stronger AI becomes, the more schools need teachers who understand special education and can put plans into practice. AI helps generate lesson plans and resources, but people must determine how to help each child truly learn. What will shrink is inefficient, one-size-fits-all instruction that simply follows the textbook. Special education teachers who use AI tools well and can still support children will become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study special education or education and earn a special education teaching credential. This field has substantial shortages, stable employment, and social value, but it demands psychological resilience. Complete an internship at a special education school first to experience the work instead of relying on assumptions. In the AI era, teachers skilled in individualized instructional design and assistive technology will be more competitive.

Use AI for lesson preparation, learning records, and adaptive learning, then devote the saved time to behavioral intervention and deeper professional development. Build expertise in psychological and behavioral intervention, rehabilitation training, or inclusive education research. The higher the professional barrier, the harder the work is to replace.

An education background is an advantage when moving into special education. First earn a special education teaching credential, then start at a special education organization or a resource room in a mainstream school. Quantifiable achievements such as the number of IEPs developed and cases of student progress are more useful on a resume than compassion alone.

When hiring special education teachers, look beyond academic credentials to emotional stability and professional competence. Teachers who can write IEPs, conduct behavioral interventions, and handle intense emotional demands are scarce. Give them adequate support and room to grow, or turnover will be high.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Goal library, templates, and progress tracking
Questions by ability level and real-time difficulty adjustment
Tiered lesson plans and resource matching
Alerts for signs of emotional fluctuations
Automatic archiving of classroom observations and assessments
Teaching aids, case studies, and visual resources

ai_s7_trends: As inclusive education policies advance, mainstream school resource rooms and special education schools are expanding, widening the shortage of special education teachers and steadily increasing demand.

AI-assisted lesson preparation, adaptive learning, and assistive technology are becoming standard in special education classrooms, allowing teachers to focus more on behavioral intervention and emotional support.
The special education teacher's role is evolving from classroom implementer to individualized education designer and home-school coordinator, earning greater professional recognition.

body: Middle school special education teachers develop and implement individualized education programs for middle school students with special educational needs. ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把一个知识点拆成十种讲法，但孩子今天不想学、坐不住的那个时刻，还得特教老师蹲下来陪他。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育教师在岗约 9.48 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.30 万人，岗位净减约 0.18 万个，年均产生约 0.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.49 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代初中特教老师，但会改变「备课和记录」这件事。以前教案全凭经验，现在 AI 能按每个孩子的 IEP 生成差异化练习、检索合适的辅助教学资源；学情记录也能自动整理。可课堂互动、行为干预、情绪支持这些核心，还得靠人——AI 给资源，但孩子愿不愿意学，是老师的事。
ai_s2_accel: AI 语音转文字/朗读：辅助阅读障碍学生学习
情绪识别辅助：AI 辅助识别学生情绪波动信号
自适应学习平台：按学生反应实时调整难度
家校沟通助手：生成个性化反馈给家长
ai_s2_auto: IEP 文档辅助：模板与目标库一键生成初稿
差异化练习生成：按能力自动出分层题目
学情记录电子化：课堂观察与评估自动归档
教育资源检索：辅助工具、教具、案例快速匹配
ai_s3_list: 行为干预与情绪支持：孩子崩溃时怎么安抚、怎么引导，机器替代不了。
课堂互动的临场判断：同一个任务，今天这么讲他不听，换个方式再试。
与孩子的信任关系：特殊孩子愿意信任你，是长期相处的结果。
个别化教学的创造性：把抽象概念变成他能懂的方式，是老师的本事。
家校协作与同理心：和家长一起扛压力，需要的是人的温度。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半任务在桌面完成——备课、记录、资源检索正被 AI 大幅辅助，但课堂互动、行为干预、情绪支持这些核心，AI 只能辅助。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 越强，越需要懂特教、能落地的老师去执行——它帮你生成教案和资源，但「怎么让这个孩子学进去」要人想办法。真正被压缩的是「只照本宣科、不个别化」的低效教学方式，会用 AI 工具、又能陪孩子的特教老师价值反而上升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读特殊教育或教育类专业，考特教教师资格证。这行缺口大、职业稳定、有社会价值，但心理素质要求高——建议先去特教学校实习感受一下，别只凭想象。AI 时代，会个别化教学设计、懂辅助技术的老师更吃香。
把 AI 备课、学情记录和自适应学习工具用起来，省下的时间花在行为干预和专业深化上。往心理行为干预、康复训练、融合教育教研方向走，专业壁垒越高越难被替代。
教育背景转特教有优势，先考特教资格证，从特教机构或普校资源教室切入。简历上写「制定 IEP 数、学生进步案例」这类可量化成果，比空有爱心有用。
招特教老师别只看学历，要看情绪稳定性和专业能力。能写 IEP、会行为干预、扛得住高情绪负荷的老师，是稀缺资源，要给足支持和发展空间，否则流失率很高。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 按能力出题、实时调难度
阅读障碍辅助、文字转语音
课堂观察、评估自动归档

ai_s7_trends: 融合教育政策推进，普校资源教室和特教学校扩招，特教老师缺口持续扩大，岗位需求稳定上升。
AI 辅助备课、自适应学习和辅助技术成为特教课堂标配，老师的精力转向行为干预与情绪支持。
特教老师角色从「课堂执行者」升级为「个别化教育设计师 + 家校协同者」，专业价值更受认可。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Navigation can mark the incision, but knowing when to pass the forceps and how to retract still depends on the understanding between the surgical assistant and the lead surgeon.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 25,300 surgical assistants were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 26,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,300 jobs, with approximately 1,600 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $60,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace surgical assistants, but it will reshape intraoperative support. Image-guided navigation and surgical robots automate some exposure and positioning tasks, shifting assistants from passing instruments toward maintaining sterility, controlling exposure, and responding to emergencies. Basic instrument passing faces displacement, while assistants who coordinate seamlessly and handle emergencies become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Real-time fusion of intraoperative imaging
Smart alerts for bleeding risk
Smart scheduling of instrument preparation
Training simulations and assessments
ai_s2_auto: Image-guided navigation for positioning
Some procedures performed by surgical robots
Barcode management for instrument counts
Smart prompts for procedural steps
ai_s3_list: Intraoperative coordination: People anticipate the surgeon's intentions.
Exposure control: People judge the proper degree of retraction.
Emergency support: People step in when unexpected events occur.
Sterile management: People uphold the protocols.
Ultimate accountability: People remain responsible for counts and errors.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates medium AI exposure. Navigation and robots assist with intraoperative tasks, but coordination and emergency response depend heavily on human teamwork.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure still creates pressure, but automation replaces basic instrument passing, not coordination and emergency response. Assistants who can anticipate the lead surgeon and respond to emergencies become scarcer as robotic surgery spreads.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong foundation in medicine or nursing and observe as many procedures as possible while in school. Routine instrument passing is shrinking in the AI era, so develop sterile technique and emergency response skills early.
Advance from knowing how to pass instruments to understanding procedures + responding to emergencies. Learn to support navigation and robotic systems, and pursue a specialty surgical assistant role.
Highlight your operating room experience and departments, and specify which procedures you have supported. Emergency department experience is preferred.
Do not recruit solely for fast hands. Evaluate sterile habits and teamwork. Assistants who can respond to emergencies deserve higher performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Surgical robots and navigation take over some tasks, shifting assistants toward coordination and emergency response.
Minimally invasive and ambulatory surgery are changing how teams coordinate.
Specialty assistants who understand navigation and robotic coordination are in greater demand.

body: Surgical assistants support surgeons during operations by passing instruments, exposing the surgical field, assisting with hemostasis and suction, and handling specimens. career_ai_description_block.heading: Navigation can mark the incision, but knowing when to pass the forceps and how to retract still depends on the understanding between the surgical assistant and the lead surgeon.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代外科助理，但会重做台上辅助。影像导航与手术机器人把部分暴露与定位自动化，助理从「递器械」转向「管无菌、控暴露、应突发」。真正被挤掉的是基础传递，能默契配合、能应急的助理更值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于没压力：被替代的是「基础传递」，不是「配合与应急」。能跟主刀、能应急的助理，反而随机器人普及更稀缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Video Game Designers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 128,900 video game designers were employed in 2024, with employment projected to rise to 137,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 9,000 jobs. The occupation generates approximately 9,100 openings annually, and median annual pay was about $98,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace video game designers, but it will reshape their workflows by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools while people focus on judgment, responsibility, and creativity. Formulaic execution faces the greatest pressure, while designers who understand real situations and make sound decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate player and audience analysis in video game design.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate game-design plan development.
Use retrieval tools to verify video game design resources and regulations.

Search video game design knowledge bases and extract key points.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist video game designers, but professional judgment and final accountability are difficult to replace, resulting in 8/10 exposure.
